title: FY2017 Section 5339 Bus and Bus Facilities grant application
source_representation: scan-only PDF; indexed/visually reviewed, full OCR pending staged extraction
purpose: FTA Section 5339 Bus and Bus Facilities Program, State Fiscal Year 2017.
compliance_evidence: Checklist includes project description/justification, vehicle/facility/equipment maintenance plans, milestone schedule, budgets and DBE goal, MPO inclusion where applicable, urban-area project inclusion where applicable, labor, displacement statement, NEPA protection statement, flood-plain evaluation, and enclosed executed compliance documents.

Executed/compliance materials listed include local civil-rights assurance, disabled assurance, authorizing resolution, certification of equivalent service, charter certification, incidental-services certification, lobbying certification, procurement information certification, school-bus operations certification, transit-agency safety-plan certification, and federally required/model contract clauses.
The project description identifies replacement vehicles as the highest-priority request and also requests mobile radios.

The project-justification section states that service demand was increasing, many vehicles had more than 200,000 miles, some proposed replacement vehicles exceeded 100,000 miles, and some older vehicles lacked air conditioning needed for disabled riders.
provenance_note: Historical capital-grant compliance evidence, not a statement of current requirements.
